doc.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Advice to young musicians and staying fit
summary: Listen to everything, play a lot, and gym fitness has helped him.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Yeah. Any words of wisdom or experience to young musicians coming out today?

Well you know I just can tell them what the guys used to tell me is just to listen to everything that you can get your hands on. Listen to all different types of music. And you know play as much as you can. And for me, I’m a gym guy so I like to be in the gym a lot. So I think that’s really helped me over the years, for being strong and for playing and for being on the road and keeping healthy. You know I don’t drink or smoke or anything like that, so that’s, the physical thing in the gym has really been a big part of helping me survive.
I think it works. I told you you didn’t look much different on this record, and you said this was almost thirty years ago.

Yeah. Well Nancy and I are getting ready to hit our big one next year, we’re both going to turn 60 you know. So I’m about four months older than she is. She likes to tell me that you know. But I’m going to have a great, we’re going to have a big party next year.
